scenes.title: ANU Large Rotating Annulus
scenes.institution: Climate and Fluid Physics Laboratory — Large Rotating Annulus
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory facility page and its installed Large Rotating Annulus photo were reviewed. ANU university tour page establishes the laboratory affiliation. The published annulus outer diameter is 1.6 m and its depth is 0.4 m; the full laboratory tour was not reviewed. Only the tank outer diameter and depth are published here. Ring thickness, pedestal, probe travel, room envelope and equipment offsets remain estimates. No thermal-fluid model or rotation-rate performance is inferred.
observed_cues: Faceted transparent circular tank surrounds a prominent hollow copper inner cylinder.
Black curtains enclose the rear and side of the annulus; a tall profiling probe support rises over the rim.
Adjacent computer desk and floor-standing instrument rack remain separate from the rotating apparatus.

equipment.role: Rotate the tank and translate the supported profiling probe around a visible inert calibration target.

scenes.title: UNSW CoreTOM Specimen Positioning Bay
scenes.institution: Tyree X-ray CT Facility — CoreTOM Micro CT-1
scenes.reference_notes: The dedicated CoreTOM instrument page and its installed source/specimen/detector photograph were inspected. It identifies LG22 in the Tyree Energy Technology Building and a 970 mm source-detector distance. This is CoreTOM evidence, distinct from the previously unreviewed Heliscan tour. Only source-detector separation is treated as published geometry. Photo does not establish a complete shielded room plan. Two authored sample axes are a subset of the nine listed motorized stages; no X-ray production, radiation shielding certification, reconstruction or porous-media physics.
observed_cues: Left source housing with visible red/blue service cables faces a large upright detector on the right.
Central slender dark core capsule is held by a white cylindrical rotary chuck above black translation stages.
A tall granite column and aluminium profiles form the rear mechanical structure.

equipment.role: Position and rotate a supported inert core capsule between static source and detector exteriors.

support.evidence: Continuous authored support from machine frame to laboratory floor; independently inspect geometry
